name: Cairn-eaters
description: Thousands of unfettered spirits who tear down stone cairns built as a tribute to Egon.

timeline.summary: A withered spirit warns Ranar of the cairn-eaters, who tear down a monument built as tribute to Egon.
timeline.quote: I realized for EGON this tribute, and my reward was the hatred of these most lost souls
